### 1 — Scene
A roast-beef meal with three small potatoes, mixed vegetables, a bottle of brown gravy, and a wrapped dessert that appears to be a chocolate-coated ice cream.

### 2 — Vessels
Estimated dimensions:
- Beef plate: **20 cm diameter**, area **314 cm²**.
- Potato dish: **18 cm diameter**, area **254 cm²**.
- Vegetable bowl: **20 cm diameter**, area **314 cm²**.
- Gravy bottle: approximately **4.5 cm internal diameter**, cross-sectional area **16 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Sliced roast beef; potatoes with herb flecks; broccoli, peas, sweetcorn and green beans; brown gravy; probable wrapped chocolate-coated ice cream. No separate oil or butter is clearly distinguishable.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Coverage percentages refer to each item’s own vessel. Heights are average pile heights, not maximum heights.

| Item | Area coverage | Gross volume calculation | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Roast beef | 45% of plate | 141 cm² × 1.0 cm = 141 ml | 0.95 | 134 g | 200 | 268 kcal |
| Three potatoes | 25% of dish | 64 cm² × 1.7 cm = 109 ml | 0.95 | 104 g | 90 | 94 kcal |
| Mixed vegetables | 43% of bowl | 135 cm² × 2.0 cm = 270 ml | 0.60 | 162 g | 55 | 89 kcal |
| Brown gravy | Bottle cross-section | 16 cm² × 6 cm filled height = 96 ml | 1.0 | 96 g | 40 | 38 kcal |
| Wrapped ice cream, probable | Contents obscured | Estimated 50 cm² × 2.3 cm = 115 ml | 0.65 | 75 g | 300 | 225 kcal |

The plated-food coverage totals are **45%, 25%, and 43%** on the respective dishes. The wrapped dessert estimate is substantially less certain because its contents are concealed.

### 8 — Sanity check
The three dishes contain approximately **400 g**, consistent with the visible portions. Including the gravy and probable dessert gives approximately **570 g and 715 kcal**.
